selection: Next 25 unresolved colleges by 2026 General Round-1 demand from the 150-profile build.
methodology: Current lived/student evidence, formal disciplinary cases, official safeguards and evidence gaps are separately labelled.
Anonymous or second-hand student claims remain allegations and are not promoted to verified institutional facts.
Official anti-ragging safeguards do not establish low lived prevalence.
No phase timing is added unless a source actually supports the timing.
Source-empty profiles are presented as evidence gaps rather than carrying unsupported reassurance or formal-control claims.
